sentences.text: The documents do not state that the KFS rules took effect on 1 January 2023.
For a UCB, the in-force KFS instructions apply to all new retail and MSME term loans sanctioned on or after October 1, 2024, including fresh loans to existing customers.
The superseded 2024 KFS circular is dated April 15, 2024.
